title: Million Dollar Spaghetti
description: A rich and creamy baked spaghetti dish with Italian sausage, ground beef, and a blend of cheeses.

ingredients.item: jar of your favorite marinara sauce

steps: Add Italian sausage and ground beef to a hot oiled pan. Break it up, season it with salt and pepper, brown it, and then drain it.
Add one diced onion and three minced garlic cloves to the pan, and then just stir those up and cook them for a few minutes until those onions are nice and soft.
Add one jar of your favorite marinara sauce. Stir that in until everything is coated, and then set the meat mixture aside.
In a mixing bowl, add one block of softened cream cheese, one cup of cottage cheese, and a quarter cup of sour cream. Mix all of this until it's beautifully combined.

In a 9x13 baking dish, add half of the cooked spaghetti to the bottom. Spread the cream cheese mixture on top. Add the rest of the noodles on top. Spread the meat mixture on top of the noodles. Spread the shredded mozzarella cheese on top. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top as well.
Throw the whole thing in the oven at 350 for about 30 minutes.
If you have parsley, throw it on top. Let this cool down. Once it's cooled down, cut a piece out, put it on a plate, and serve.
notes:
Let the spaghetti cool down before serving.
